name: Beads
description: See and act on the beads tasks of your Orca workspace: the current task, ready work, epics, comments, and launching an agent on a task.

screenshots.caption: The task in progress, then what is ready, by epic or all at once.
screenshots.alt: Three Beads panels: the Ready tab, the Epics tab with progress bars, and the All tab.

screenshots.caption: Everything about a task, in light and dark. Finish it with a reason.
screenshots.alt: A task opened in the Beads panel, in light and dark, and the finish form asking for a reason.

screenshots.caption: Launch an agent, create a task, without leaving Orca.
screenshots.alt: The launch form with agent, worktree and prompt; the new task form; the Ready tab in dark.
